purpose: Prevent one flat publication lag from being treated as point-in-time evidence for heterogeneous economic series.
historical_rule: A historical observation may enter a decision only when an archived or otherwise verified available_at timestamp is no later than the decision timestamp.

india_gsec.required_timing: instrument/value observable before decision; security identity recorded

fed_assets.required_timing: actual release timestamp, not observation-period end

broad_usd.required_timing: aggregate must consist only of observations known before decision

rbi_repo.required_timing: policy rate effective at decision timestamp

research_sensitivity_allowed: Assumed lags may be shown as sensitivities if clearly labelled non-vintage and never used to certify the full stack.
